t.name: Salmonberry Trail
t.description: The Salmonberry Trail is a planned "rail-and-trail" hiking and biking trail through the Oregon Coast Range along the Salmonberry River in northwest Oregon, United States.

t.name: Timber-Wilson River Path
t.description: Small footpath following along Gales Creek. The path has a number of offshoots leading down to the creek itself. Not all parts of the path are publically accessible, as parts of it are private property.
